title: Corvus image build pipeline
description: Authoring schema for crv build YAML, before client-side variable and local-file preprocessing. Unknown Corvus fields are rejected. Runtime resource and semantic validation still applies.

size.description: Positive integral size with B, K, M, G or T suffix (binary units). RAM must resolve to whole MiB; overflow and alignment are checked at runtime. Quote variable references.

cloudInit.description: Cloud-init payloads are unrestricted YAML values; their contents are not validated here.

diskSelector.description: Disk image name, name:tag, or positive numeric ID. Name and tag rules are checked at runtime.

ifExists.description: Publication policy for an existing image: error, skip, overwrite, or update.

rebase.description: Publish a standalone image. Only supported for overlay and offline-overlay; false retains backing and requires qcow2.

cpuCount.description: Number of virtual CPUs in the temporary build VM.

ram.description: Build VM RAM, using binary units; must resolve to whole MiB.

delaySec.description: Delay before sending the key sequence, in seconds.

node.description: Node name or ID; offline-overlay defaults to an online source-image host, other strategies use the default node.

strategy.description: Build strategy: overlay captures a template disk; from-scratch populates an empty disk; installer boots installation media; offline-overlay modifies a separate source image using a helper VM.

cleanup.description: Resource cleanup: always, only on success (onSuccess), or never.

bootKeys.description: Key sequences sent during guest boot.

waitForShutdownSec.description: Maximum time to wait for shutdown, in seconds.

sourceImage.description: Registered artifact source; required only for offline-overlay. Resolved once before baking.
